u03-rem-mid.resolution: I checked each flag against the Greek and found no meaning error. 'Thus God made him the father of twice as many children as he had been father of before' renders ὥστε καὶ πατέρα διπλασίων παίδων αὐτὸν πεποίηκεν ὁ Θεός, ὧν ἦν πρότερον πατήρ. 'Since he received back all good things double, if he also received back …' keeps ἐάν as 'if' and gives the participle ἀπολαβών causal force, with the same sense. The rest is idiom.
